theory: The product-rule fact incorrectly applies 'full lengths from that point' to intersecting chords. For intersecting chords, multiply the two segments of each chord measured from their internal intersection; for external secants, multiply the external segment by the full secant length, and equate this to the tangent length squared when applicable.
